s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of skin and muscle symptoms following immunotherapy
salient_findings: Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 50s
Patient has stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
Patient has metastases of the liver, lungs, and peritoneum
Patient developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment
Patient received a second course of ipilimumab 14 months later
Patient has diffuse erythema of forehead and midface
Patient has erythema and edema of upper eyelids
Patient has elevated creatine kinase levels
Patient has elevated C-reactive protein levels
Patient has antinuclear antibody titer of 1:640 with speckled pattern
Patient has muscle weakness and fatigue
Patient has limited flexion of both hips
Patient has reduced activity level due to weakness and early fatigue

raw.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of skin and muscle symptoms following immunotherapy
salient_findings: Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 50s
Patient has stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
Patient has metastases of the liver, lungs, and peritoneum
Patient developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment
Patient received a second course of ipilimumab 14 months later
Patient has diffuse erythema of forehead and midface
Patient has erythema and edema of upper eyelids
Patient has elevated creatine kinase levels
Patient has elevated C-reactive protein levels
Patient has antinuclear antibody titer of 1:640 with speckled pattern
Patient has muscle weakness and fatigue
Patient has limited flexion of both hips
Patient has reduced activity level due to weakness and early fatigue

raw.rationale: The patient's skin symptoms, such as photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption, diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, and flagellate erythema, along with muscle weakness, elevated creatine kinase levels, and antinuclear antibody titer of 1:640 with speckled pattern, are consistent with dermatomyositis, especially given the temporal association with ipilimumab treatment.

rejected.label: melanoma
rejected.why: While the patient has melanoma, the skin and muscle symptoms described are not typical of melanoma itself.

rejected.label: myositis
rejected.why: Myositis is a broader term that encompasses several conditions, including dermatomyositis and polymyositis; dermatomyositis is a more specific diagnosis that better explains the patient's skin symptoms.

rejected.label: polymyositis
rejected.why: Polymyositis is an inflammatory muscle disease without skin involvement, which does not fit the patient's presentation of skin symptoms.

rejected.label: sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Sarcoidosis can cause skin and muscle symptoms, but the patient's specific symptoms, such as flagellate erythema and the pattern of muscle weakness, are more characteristic of dermatomyositis.
